text: Program Description Note: Tuition fee for the first year is RMB 15,000, for second to sixth year is RMB 25,000/year. (1) Program Introduction GMU Clinical Medicine program, established in 1938, is the earliest founded core major in school with most solid foundation and strongest advantage. The program is recognized by WCAME, WHO, ECFMG, CMC. (2) Study Duration: 6 years Including one year internship. (3) Tuition fee: Calculated in RMB
